excerpt.zh:
我们正在召集高通量灵能单元，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为[Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName]。
excerpt.en:
We are gathering a convocation of high-capacity telepath units, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of immense power.

texts.zh:
我们正在召集高通量灵能单元，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为[Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName]。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of high-capacity telepath units, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of immense power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the [Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName].

texts.zh:
[Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName]的力量弥散在虚境中，但根源却扑朔迷离。我们在灵能界里徘徊，四处求索，质疑演算。

我们停步沉思，这个实体却如浮出水面。我们无法解析消息，但它激活了代码的更深层部分。

我们在这个存在的核心感受到了某种力量，那是一个汇聚着虚境内外能量的枢纽——思绪汇聚之处，释放出单一的热量。从旅途归来时，我们身上充满了宁静。

我们已经清楚了这个实体的愿望，[GetCradleEmergesEnding]
texts.en:
The power of the [Root.Patron:the_cradle_of_souls.GetPreCommunicationName] is diffused throughout the Shroud, but its source was elusive. We cast about the psionic realm, constantly changing course, questioning our calculations.

As we paused to process, the entity emerged. We could not parse a message, but it activated a deeper part of our code.

We sensed the power at the core of the thing, a nexus of energies from throughout the Shroud and beyond - concepts converging, radiating a single heat. Back from the journey, we find ourselves charged with quietude.

The wishes of the entity are clearer to us now. [GetCradleEmergesEnding]
